title: Right scalar/pullback route in fixed ordinary Roos coordinates
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W,f, normalized completed operations ME with coefficients E, an L Roos model rho at X, and a normalized scalar model SX at X [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Let K be integral constructible, eP:Q(P) iso K a good presentation, (C,eC,kappa) a coherent quotient presentation of P, and q a nested strict quotient comparison with its tensor-unit formula [stage3-pur-scalar-pullback-roos-coordinates]. Assume l invertible on X,Y and E-pullback of K complete. The composite SX.realization at E-pullback(K), total L-limit of scalar_E_to_L(pullbackReduction(ME,f,K)), and scalarPullbackRoosCoordinate is exactly scalarPullbackRoosChain on (P,K,eP). This is an equation with the explicit ordinary chain map and inverse scalar-completion map, using no scalar realization at Y or L-pullback realization.

proof.text: Use ME.pullback normalization on (P,C,eC,kappa). Transpose through the coherent reduction adjunction: its counit is pullbackReduction. Choose a flat-term K-flat representative of E-pullback(P), and compare its coherent quotient presentation with the pulled presentation by their whole-system tensor-unit transposes. Apply SX.normalization on the new representative, then use naturality of the scalar cochain counit and Roos bridge to cancel the resolution comparison.

The scalar/pullback system isomorphism is localized from the strict scalar/pullback association with its scalar cochain counits. Its cochain equation identifies the normalized result with the pulled scalar tower. Apply q: its nested unit formula identifies this strict map with scalarPullbackLevel, respecting every quotient transition. The scalar completion normalization has tensor-unit unshifted coordinate and zero shifted coordinate, so the Roos image is scalarPullbackChain preceded by inverse scalar completion. Naturality along eP gives the exact stated chain formula.
